http/http1_writing#

Writing HTTP/1.1 heads: checked and bounded before a single write.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Writing HTTP/1.1 heads: checked and bounded before a single write.

Public API#

object Http1RequestHeadWriting#

object Http1RequestHeadWriting

Canonical head bytes are fully bounded/validated before a lazy single write. Sink is borrowed. Started failure may emit a prefix: discard the session.

Http1RequestHeadWriting.Http1RequestHeadWriting#

Http1RequestHeadWriting(origin is AsyncWriting, head is Http1RequestHead)

Writes head to origin within the default limits.

Http1RequestHeadWriting(origin is AsyncWriting, head is Http1RequestHead, limits is Http1Limits)

The same within limits.

Http1RequestHeadWriting.output#

output() is Future<AsyncWriting>

Writes the head; the future gives the writer back when done.

object Http1RequestHeadWire#

object Http1RequestHeadWire

The bytes of a head, for a writer that sends the head and a body that is already in memory in one write (#115). The head knows its framing plan, made once for the writer and for the check before the bytes (#503).

head within limits.
